subject: Request: Community Credits for DocuStream Maintainers & Volunteer Mentors
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@docustream.org>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Community credits for maintainers + mentors (June DocuStream Hack)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the earlier intro — really appreciate Redwood's support for open-source projects. We're running our annual DocuStream Community Hack (June 18-20) and want to provide compute + trial credits to maintainers and volunteer mentors so they can spin up demos and prototypes during the event.

Quick ask: could Redwood provide a pool of trial credits for ~25 maintainers (core + emeritus) and 40 volunteer mentors? We're thinking 1,000 USD equivalent in credits per maintainer and 300 USD per mentor (or token-equivalent guidance).

I've attached a short request doc with the list and schedule. If helpful, I can share a short rundown on how we plan to prevent abuse (team verification, project registration).

We'd love to include Redwood as a sponsor in our community announcement and on the event page.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Community Relations
DocuStream

Attachments: DocuStream_Credits_Request.pdf, hackathon_schedule.ics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@docustream.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Community credits for maintainers + mentors (June DocuStream Hack)

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the note and the clear asks. This sounds like a great community event and aligns with our maintainer support program. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I tee this up for approval:

- Confirm the total USD-equivalent pool you expect (25 * 1,000 + 40 * 300 = $34,000) — is that the ask or is there flexibility?
- Are all maintainers on the attached list public project maintainers (we need repo links for verification)?
- Do you want credits issued as one-time promo codes, per-account trial extensions, or a consolidated monthly billing credit to the org?

I'm copying Marissa and Karthik to vet from sponsor/credit policy and partnerships. Happy to schedule a quick 20-min call today if helpful.

—Rishi
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--- Original attachment referenced: DocuStream_Credits_Request.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Community credits for maintainers + mentors (June DocuStream Hack)

Rishi / Karthik —

I've reviewed the DocuStream packet. High-level thoughts:

- $34k total is a reasonable ask for a community sponsor package, but we should consider a tiered approach: confirmed maintainers get the full $1k equivalent; mentors get a smaller fixed amount (e.g., $200) to keep the pool manageable.
- Recommend issuing credits as single-use promo codes tied to email domains for verification (docustream.org) — easier to audit than org-level billing credits.
- Need to confirm fraud controls: project registration + quick mentor verification form. We can require that maintainers register a public repo link to unlock the full allocation.

If we go tiered (25 x $1k + 40 x $200) total = $25k. Approveable under the community sponsorship budget if we mark it as 'promotional' and require event co-branding.

I can approve up to $25k in promo credits pending legal review of the T&Cs and a one-page sponsor acknowledgement.

-Marissa
Senior Manager, Developer Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Community credits for maintainers + mentors (June DocuStream Hack)

Thanks — agree with the tiered ask. A few operational notes if we proceed:

- We should generate time-limited promo codes (valid for 90 days) that map to internal SKU 'COMM-MAINT-2026' and 'COMM-MENTOR-2026'. Ops can track redemptions by code.
- I'll loop Legal for a brief sponsor acknowledgement (IP disclaimers + usage limits).
- Stephanie, can you confirm whether Support needs to staff on-call during the hack weekend? If so, we should flag it to CS.

If Support staffing is required, we may convert some of the promo budget into a short-term Dedicated burst seat to avoid widespread trial provisioning on shared capacity. That would be a product/infra cost trade-off.

-Karthik
Partnerships Strategy Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@docustream.org>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ashok Patel <ashok@openhack.co>
Date: 2026-05-14T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Community credits for maintainers + mentors (June DocuStream Hack)

Amazing — thank you all for the quick review and the tiered proposal. DocuStream confirms we can require repo links and mentor verification forms. We also agree to Redwood branding on the event page and in the community email.

Please let us know the next steps for promo codes and any sponsor acknowledgement language. We're happy to sign a one-page form.

Appreciate the partnership — excited to get this live.

Best,
Lena
Director, Community Relations
DocuStream
